description: This file defines an internal interface 'ISiloStatisticsChangeListener' for receiving notifications about silo statistics changes and removal in the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: ISiloStatisticsChangeListener
classes.description: An internal interface for listening to silo statistics change events and silo removal notifications in Orleans.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Method called when new silo statistics are available to notify the listener of the update.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Method called to notify the listener that a silo has been removed.
